caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica means accepting that some climbs cannot be ridden. When the dirt track turns to wet grass and the gradient crosses thirty percent, the fastest way forward is often the oldest one: on foot, shoulder to shoulder with the slope. Here, the landscape does not compromise for gears. You push, you breathe, and you let the ridge open up around you. There is no rush to the top when the view is this wide.
